description: Defines the ProductEntity class, a Java entity representing product data with various attributes such as price, dimensions, SKU, and ratings, used in the sales manager web application.

classes.name: ProductEntity
classes.description: A Java class extending Product, representing a product with additional attributes like price, dimensions, SKU, ratings, and availability.

methods.description: Returns the product's price.
